en: The image is a colored vintage postcard showing a quiet, tree-lined street with a child walking down the road. There are classic European houses with gable roofs and dark shutters on the left, and a wind-powered water pump tower is visible in the background. The street is bordered by neatly trimmed hedges and tall trees. The lower right corner of the postcard contains the text 'BERG EN DAL.'
